observation_source: User reply: 还没刷; interpreted only for the incoming uncommitted experiment.
changes: Retired all-slot SMR write scan; obsolete argument now panics before controller access.
Read-only report runs before transport/queue/DMA/root setup and terminates in a diagnostic panic.
Collector uses SMMUv2 ID0 at 0x20 instead of sCR0 at 0; handles SMS and EXIDS.
Context-bank candidate starts at ID1.NUMS2CB rather than a guessed bank 1; takeover remains unverified.
limits: No inference of permanent secure-world ownership from ignored SMR writes.
Current BoardInit.c calls both SCM functions before the first result marker, so that marker alone cannot identify a nonreturning second call.
SCM call availability and ABI convention must be qualified before restoring configuration; no such secure-world call is made by this diagnostic.
Candidate SIDs 0x60/0xe0/0x4e0 are hypotheses, not board routing proof.
